messages:
Asha (Marketing): Need a concise enterprise one-pager focused on security + SLA options for next week's field drop. Deliverables: 1-page PDF, 2 benchmark callouts for slides, 3 subject lines, and routing rules. Who can take what?

Ben (Product): I'll draft the SLA and deploy-mode bullets (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). ETA: Tue noon.

Kali (Field SE): I'll write a 5-item security checklist and two quick AE scripts for calls. Also propose routing: keywords [private, SOC2, SLA] -> AE + Field SE.

Ravi (Eng): I'll export two simple charts (p95 latency by mode, token cost relative). Will attach test notes. PNGs 1200x800. ETA: Tue EOD.

Mei (Design): I can do the one-pager and slides if copy is ready by Tue 4pm. Prefer light background.

Asha (Marketing): Draft email subjects (tone variants) please:
1) "SLA-backed LLM inference for regulated teams"
2) "Secure, predictable inference — Hosted, Dedicated, or Private"
3) "Request a security review & pilot"

Ben (Product): SLA draft: "Dedicated: 99.95% uptime SLA; 24/7 enterprise support; latency targets published per model/profile." Sending to legal.

legal-bot: Legal acknowledged. Review SLA wording; avoid absolute claims about data residency without contract language. Allow 24-48h.

Kali (Field SE): Battle card snippets:
- "Can data stay in our VPC?" -> Yes with Private (on-prem/VPC).
- "Key management?" -> Integrates with KMS/HSM; customer controls rotation.

Asha (Marketing): Routing rules confirmed: default -> SDR. If message contains keywords [private, SOC2, HIPAA, SLA, HSM] -> tag enterprise -> AE + Field SE. If asks for artifacts -> tag security-review -> Customer Security + AE.

Asha (Marketing): Timeline recap: copy Tue noon, design Tue 4pm, legal Wed, ship to field Wed EOD. Ping here with edits. Thanks! :sparkles:
